name: Critter
description: Critter Format, named after the OCG's Sangan, is the second Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG format. The latest core set is Metal Raiders (MRD). Notable additions include many new Effect Monsters, Heavy Storm, and Mirror Force. For the first time, we see a clear split in play-styles between Aggro and Control. Players can also set up win conditions via OTKs with cards like Cannon Soldier.

defining_cards.name: Sangan
defining_cards.why: Sending it from the field to the Graveyard searched out a low-ATK monster, from a combo piece to another defensive play.

defining_cards.name: Witch of the Black Forest
defining_cards.why: Its 1500 DEF search limit reached high-ATK monsters such as Summoned Skull, replacing the Witch when it left the field for the Graveyard.

defining_cards.name: Mirror Force
defining_cards.why: A single attack could cost the opponent every Attack Position monster, discouraging them from committing several attackers.

defining_cards.name: Magician of Faith
defining_cards.why: Its Flip Effect recovered a spent Spell, giving decks a second use of cards such as Pot of Greed.

defining_cards.name: Cannon Soldier
defining_cards.why: It turned spare monsters into 500 damage apiece, letting combo decks finish a duel without attacking.
